definitions: Allow the existence, occurrence, or practice of (something that one does not necessarily like or agree with) without interference.
Accept or endure (someone or something unpleasant or unwelcome) with patience or restraint.
Be able to take or be exposed to (a drug, typically without adverse side effects).
Allow (a plant or animal) to grow or live in (particular conditions) without harm.
examples: A regime which tolerated no dissent.
She could no longer tolerate the pain.
Some patients tolerate the drug well.
The plants tolerate a wide range of conditions.
